about_the_game:
A fantasy-styled sexy alchemy RPG!

Mage of darkness Aisha has been turned into a futanari! Despite her newfound phallus, work's not going to end just because of some changes down below. She still has many new ingredients left to find! Aisha is an alchemist with a very unique specialization... She makes and sells adult merchandise for everyone's sexy needs!

With every use of her new adult products, she releases her special spermagic, which is the key to defeating the dark mage who transformed her into a futa!

Join Aisha on her alchemist adventures as she battles against the forces of darkness to reclaim her former body!

Explore a Fantasy World

Venture through diverse environments and mysterious dungeons in search of rare ingredients for Aisha’s crafting.

Alchemy

Harness the power of alchemy to create powerful tools, potions, and equipment that aid Aisha on her journey.

Gain Power

Level up through combat and crafting, unlocking new abilities and items to take on tougher challenges.

Outfit Customization

Collect and unlock a variety of stylish outfits for Aisha to wear throughout her adventure.

Black Market

Need a little boost? The black market lets you get ahead quickly, whether you're stuck or just want to keep the story moving.

Live2D Animation

Experience beautifully animated character art with expressive movements and reactions brought to life with Live2D.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 11/10/8
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
